name: Scholars of the South Tigris

categories.label: Dice sum VP (black banner)
categories.hint: Dice sum = coloured dice minus white dice (all dice owned). Lowest sum takes lowest banner space, etc.; tied players share the VP of their spaces (rounded down). Enter VP read from the banner.

categories.label: Retired translators
categories.hint: VP printed on Retired Translators under your Player Board.

categories.label: Guilds controlled + Caliph card Influence
categories.labelVi: Guild kiểm soát + Influence trên thẻ Caliph
categories.hint: VP from controlled Guilds plus Influence on top (3 VP) and middle (1 VP) spaces of Caliph Cards.

categories.label: Research tracks
categories.hint: Per marker: level 7 = 5 VP, 6 = 4, 5 = 3, levels 3-4 = 2, levels 1-2 = 1. Enter number of markers at each level group.

categories.label: Scroll cards
categories.hint: VP of each Scroll Card above your Player Board; cards sharing a condition each score in full.

categories.label: Employed translators on Main Board (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Dịch giả đang làm việc (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Most Employed Translators still on the Main Board
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: engine-building-points. Game end triggered when all 4 Caliph Cards are revealed; finish the round plus one final round. Gold left on Employed Translators goes to supplies (no VP). Dice-sum banner VP per player count not verified (2p example: two tied players gain 1 VP each; 4p example: 6+4+2 across top three, 0 for last), so entered as VP. Solo vs automa not modelled.
